mentions.name: All Your Words
mentions.description: A Mac app that listens to the user's microphone and gives real-time feedback on speaking pace, filler words, and similar habits.
mentions.problem: The author tends to get carried away in meetings and wanted a tool to keep their speaking in check.
mentions.audience: Built for the author's own use, with an open question about whether others have the same need.
